118:     };

171:         }

176:     }
177:   } else if (Array.isArray(question.expectedAnswer)) {
178:     const foundItems = question.expectedAnswer.filter((item) =>
179:       normalized.includes(normalizeAnswer(item)),

182:       return { passed: true, failureType: 'PASS', reasons: ['all expected items found'] };
183:     }
